answer: A voting identity is issued only after locking a time-delayed, slashable deposit labeled inlet and keeping a unique non-parallelizable liveness transcript. Independent auditors replay those transcripts against a shared cipher of funding graphs, keys, and puzzle clocks; a proven collision seizes every linked deposit into a horizon bounty paid to the prover. Standing up N voters therefore costs N rising deposits and N live unschedulable work streams, and one detected clone wipes the cohort, so a cheap majority cannot break even.
